rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "To avoid the center effect, 164 healthy individuals and 91 FEDN-MDD patients (60 females) from the same center were included."

rci2_using_epd.detail: Data from International Big-Data Center for Depression Research (IBCDR); IBCDR is not on the EPD list. Referenced papers (Deng et al., 2022; Ding et al., 2022) suggest a relationship with REST-meta-MDD, but the paper explicitly names IBCDR as the data source, not REST-meta-MDD.

rci3_epd_name.detail: RCI-2 = No; reference data is from IBCDR (in-house consortium dataset, not on EPD list)

rci5_n.detail: Overall phase; 91 healthy-base controls matched from 164 HC at the same center using MatchIt on sex, age, and education; 10-fold CV used for normative model aggregation (no separate train/test split reported for HC demographics)
rci5_n.supporting_text: "we used the matchIt function in R ... to select the comparable group from the healthy controls as the healthy-base group for the patients on the following characteristic: sex, age, and educational levels." ; Table 1: Healthy-base Group N = 91
rci5_n.location: Jing2023.pdf.md: Methods / 2.1, L91; Results / Table 1, L146

rci6_sex.detail: Overall phase; Table 1 header reads 'Gender (male)' but values represent female counts — confirmed by: (1) text stating '91 FEDN-MDD patients (60 females)', (2) Table 2 'Gender (female)' showing 59 females in 89 FEDN-MDD patients, (3) p = .52 for sex matching is consistent only with healthy-base having ~65 females (Yates-corrected chi-square ≈ 0.41, p ≈ .52). male_n = 91 − 65 = 26 estimated by subtraction.
rci6_sex.supporting_text: "164 healthy individuals and 91 FEDN-MDD patients (60 females) from the same center were included." ; Table 1: Healthy-base Group Gender = 65 (p = .52) ; Table 2: Gender (female) Subtype I = 10, Subtype II = 49
